tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions, so no connection, internal hosts included, is exempt from verification or falls back to plain HTTP.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision. It says certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions. Because of that, internal hosts aren't exempt and don't fall back to plain HTTP.

The two current records behind it are "verification on all builds" (#22) and "https everywhere, no exceptions" (#25). I left out the retired positions (disabling verification in dev builds, and plain HTTP for internal hosts), as you asked.
